title: Phrasebook
description: Everyday phrases to look up when you need one, from {ça va} to {n'est-ce pas}.

vocabulary.gloss: how's it going? / it's going fine
vocabulary.note: With a rising voice it asks how someone is. Said flat, it answers.
vocabulary.example_fr: Salut, ça va ? Oui, ça va bien.
vocabulary.example_en: Hi, how's it going? Yes, it's going well.

vocabulary.note: It is a little fuller than {ça va ?} and just as friendly.
Say it to someone you call {vous}, or to a group. With a friend, say {excuse-moi}.
vocabulary.example_en: Excuse me, where is the station?

vocabulary.note: To someone you call {vous}, say {s'il vous plaît}.
vocabulary.example_fr: Passe-moi le pain, s'il te plaît.

vocabulary.note: Use it to ask politely for something in a shop or café.
vocabulary.example_fr: Je voudrais un croissant, s'il vous plaît.
vocabulary.example_en: I would like a croissant, please.

vocabulary.example_fr: Tu viens ce soir ? Bien sûr !
vocabulary.example_en: Are you coming tonight? Of course!

vocabulary.example_fr: Je vais au cinéma de temps en temps.
vocabulary.example_en: I go to the cinema from time to time.

vocabulary.note: Before an adjective, add {de}: {quelque chose de bon}.
vocabulary.example_fr: Tu veux quelque chose à boire ?
vocabulary.example_en: Do you want something to drink?

vocabulary.note: It takes the {il} form of the verb: {tout le monde est là}.
Put it at the end of a sentence to ask someone to agree.
vocabulary.example_en: The weather is nice, isn't it?

sections.heading: Saying hello
sections.text: {Ça va ?} asks how someone is. The answer uses the same words: {ça va}.

sections.heading: Being polite
sections.text: Say {excusez-moi} to get someone's attention and {je voudrais} to ask for something. Say {s'il vous plaît} to a stranger and {s'il te plaît} to a friend.

examples.fr: Excusez-moi, je voudrais un café, s'il vous plaît.
examples.en: Excuse me, I would like a coffee, please.

sections.heading: In conversation
sections.text: You will hear these words in everyday talk.

examples.fr: Je vais au café de temps en temps.
examples.en: I go to the café from time to time.

examples.fr: Tout le monde aime le chocolat, n'est-ce pas ?
